name: EasyEcom
shortInfo: The EasyEcom integration enables merchants to track and allocate inventory across online and offline sales channels in an automated manner.
brief: Simplified omnichannel retailing for sellers. Manage, track and maximize multichannel sales potential with a centralized dashboard to take channel-level control over inventory.
about:
Omni-channel ERP to simplify your INVENTORY, WAREHOUSING, PURCHASING, RECONCILIATION and ACCOUNTING.  
Learn more about [EasyEcom API documentation.](https://www.easyecom.io/)
